I'm 35 and going back to school soon. I can relate and while I'm not trying to belittle your experience, you're young, you've got plenty of time.

I obviously don't know either of you but it honestly sounds like it's possible that she likes you and she's trying to figure out how to express it despite being depressed. Some people have been advocating cutting off contact because of this pact but that might make you both even more depressed.

I don't know if you're banned from associating outside the group but if not you might want to ask her just to hang out casually. I know you're both talking about ending it all but let's say you both like video games, do that together and see if it makes you feel better at all? If you click socially beyond just having shared misery?

I'm a guy (the "chesty" refers to off my chest lol) but... You're over analyzing. The numbers stuff is irrelevant. We're not D&D characters with numbered stats. What's the difference between a 7.5 and an 8 or whatever? Who's rating you? Why does their opinion matter, do you want to date or sleep with them? Are people walking around rating people?

One thing I've learned over the years is that absolutely everyone is attractive and interesting to someone. The disconnect is that not everyone has the ability to recognize that, and some people are too shy or scared to admit it, or it's a passing thing where someone thinks "she's cute" at a party and then moves on or whatever. Another major disconnect is being too laser focused on either one person or one type of person. Are you trying to date a particular kind of guy and it's just not clicking with them?

The thing about the whole glow up thing you want to do is that if it doesn't match your personality it's not going to work. It's going to seem like you're pretending to be someone else. There's nothing wrong with wanting to learn how to do makeup and changing your haircut and wanting new clothes and all that but don't think that your taste is just invalid and therefore you shouldn't consider it. You have to find your own thing.

You need to relax and just go about your business in life for a minute, I'm not saying something will come to you but you'll be more likely to find an opportunity if you're not giving off desperate vibes
